queue.instructions: Which SOC investigation queue should triage this alert?

criteria.cloud_iam: Credential abuse, privilege escalation, unauthorised API keys, IAM policy or role changes
criteria.network_ddos: Volumetric traffic anomalies, SYN floods, port scans, WAF rate-limit triggers
criteria.endpoint_malware: Malicious processes, reverse shells, memory injection, ransomware behaviour on a host
criteria.benign_noise: Verified internal automation, approved scans, backups, health checks, expected load

quarantine.instructions: Should the source entity be automatically blocked or its credentials revoked right now?

criteria.true: Active or imminent compromise where blocking now prevents further damage
criteria.false: Suspicious but containable, expected activity, or not enough evidence to justify an automatic block

blast_radius.instructions: How severe is the realistic impact of the activity in this alert, judged from the evidence shown? Verified routine or expected activity has negligible impact.
criteria: Negligible: routine or self-contained, no realistic impact
Low: one unprivileged user or workstation affected
Moderate: multiple users, service degradation, or a lateral movement attempt
Critical: admin or root credentials, production database, or wide compromise
